checks.D2: every executed action has an approval_granted before it
checks.D3: the approver is a human principal, not an agent credential
checks.D4: the executed arguments digest equals the digest of what the card rendered
checks.D5: the approval token was bound to that same tool and digest
checks.D6: an edited plan supersedes: the first card is left DENIED, one card approved
checks.D7: an episode with no approval executed nothing

ev_gate.why: the expected-value gate (twin/ev_gate.py) is OFF for this measurement: every episode here is a frozen demo pack driven to a decision, and the chain being checked is what happens to a card once one exists. With the gate on the hero pack raises no card, because the twin prices its expedite at 0.0000 rollover probability before and after; that is measured in agentcore/tests/test_ev_gate_ledger.py instead

honest_limits: SYNTHETIC scenario packs on the deterministic replay tier; this proves the display to execution chain holds for these episodes, not that an operator in a real terminal read the card before approving it
